courses.title: Motors and Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: A worksheet pack on driving and controlling motors with microcontrollers — DC, stepper and servo motors, motor-control circuits and actuator projects.

courses.title: Sensors and Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: A worksheet pack exploring how microcontrollers read the world through sensors — analog and digital inputs, temperature and light sensing, and data acquisition.

courses.title: Microcontrollers for T-Levels
courses.shortDescription: A curriculum worksheet pack supporting the T-Level microcontrollers units, with ready-to-use embedded systems exercises for the classroom.

courses.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers

courses.title: Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians
courses.shortDescription: A curriculum worksheet pack covering digital techniques for aviation technicians, with avionics-focused exercises aligned to EASA Part-66 study.

courses.title: Flowcode and E-blocks 3 CPD Course
courses.shortDescription: A continuing professional development course that brings teachers and trainers up to speed with Flowcode and the E-blocks 3 hardware. Work through flowchart-based programming and hands-on embedded exercises ready to take straight back into the classroom.
